notes.note: This and the other identical rows (012/013/014/015/017/019/024) reuse the established 'You can report quests...' wording; each is the final OkWinIn of its Quest0NN.bla after the completion message (e.g. Quest011 +72 completed, +76 this row).
Quest016.bla +68, CHARA_NAME 36 = Ankh. Wrong-party branch: follows Baltan's 'Bring me Ultraman' (row 68); 'kondo mo' = 'this time too'.

Not referenced by Quest018.bla (max offset +162), so unused; speaker unknown. Rough 'oi ... zo' voice, kept as a party member's rough line. 'G-Gan' (slang for G Gundam) rendered God Gundam per corpus convention; 'katana' rendered 'sword' to match the 'Rusty Sword' reward earlier in the scene.
Quest020.bla: Pt_Chara_Check(10) then OkWinIn(+85). Matches the existing party-requirement wording.

Unused (Quest021.bla max offset +130). The title here differs from the quest list, which has 'Backing Up Altron' (QuestMess #0.22); this one says 'rescue', so rendered 'Rescuing Altron' - likely an old title.
Quest022.bla +29, CHARA_NAME 271 = Shadow Moon (wrong-party branch). 'Kisamara' = contemptuous 'you lot'.

Quest023.bla checks Pt_Chara_Check(14) at the start; the linear decompile shows OkWinIn(+89) after Quest_SetComplete, which is presumably the fail branch of that check. Text is the standard party-requirement line.
Quest025.bla +40, CHARA_NAME 36 = Ankh (wrong-party branch). '...ta hazu da' = 'I'm pretty sure I told you'.
Unused: Tutorial_01.bla plays +0..+13 only (rows 15 and 16 never play). Referent unclear (likely HERO/Crossover Skills or the red Color Timer crit boost); translated literally and neutrally.
Tutorial_02.bla plays +10 after row 7 (two kinds of Forces), before row 8.
Tutorial_07.bla plays +13 after row 4 (idle heroes gain EXP), so 'that Idle Action' = each hero's set action.

Tutorial closers 0003-0011 all play as the last line of their scripts; worded like the existing 'That concludes the Battle/Chip Tutorial.' with the lowercase 'tutorial' of their 'Starting the X tutorial.' openers.

report: 27/27 rows. Uncertain: QuestEventMess018#0.289 (unused, speaker unknown), QuestEventMess021#0.262 (title 'Rescuing Altron' differs from quest list 'Backing Up Altron'), MainEventMess0001#0.16 (unused, referent unclear). No new names.
